Maria D: Quick heads-up — ran a canary with cohort overrides and noticed ~30% of traffic that should've been pinned to cohort B routed to fallback model instead. :thinking:
Ajay K: Yikes. Do you have the rollout config? Which matcher fired?
Maria D: Paste below — it's a weighted split with header override + cohort fallback.
Maria D: ```json
{"match": [{"header":"x-experiment","equals":"cohort-b"}], "weight": 0.3, "fallback": "model-v2"}
```
Kevin L: That config looks fine. Are you seeing header and session stickiness both present? We had ambiguity where session cookie wins but was not tagged with cohort value.
Maria D: Yep that's it — session cookie `rd_session` existed from previous routing without cohort metadata, so session-stickiness routed to default. Repro steps: 1) hit with non-cohort to set session, 2) later send header x-experiment=cohort-b, 3) request landed on default.
Robin S: Hmm this sounds like ordering problem between header-first match vs session affinity. Our intended policy is header match should supersede session stickiness for canaries.
Ajay K: Agreed. Current evaluator applies stickiness pre-match for performance reasons. We could change to run lightweight header checks before session lookup.
Kevin L: Are we concerned about perf? Header check is O(1) — session lookup involves external KV for some deployments.
Maria D: For Hosted we do local cookie decode so cheap, but for Private with remote session store it's extra call. Maybe implement a fast-path: if header present then skip session read.
Ajay K: Implementation plan: short-circuit session read when any explicit route-match header is present. Add telemetry counter: 'routing.short_circuit.header_present'.
Robin S: Also add a canary assert in console to show 'active override source' for each request in trace logs.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout updated: rollback initiated for experiment 'cohort-b' — 15:42 UTC :gear:
Maria D: thanks — creating a small PR to short-circuit session read + tests. Will add e2e with mixed cookie/header combos.
Kevin L: Please include perf benchmark (latency tail) and feature-flag for Private deploys.
Ajay K: Also add fallback-order unit test: header wins > session > default-weight > global-fallback.
Maria D: PR: https://git.company.redwood/r/redwood/infra/merge/1234 — contains code + telemetry. :white_check_mark:
Robin S: Reviewed quickly, left a comment about metrics naming. Approving after renaming.
Maria D: Merging now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment started to canary (infra-tier). ETA ~3m :rocket:
Kevin L: Watching logs — routing.short_circuit.header_present incremented. Good.
Maria D: Re-run canary with the same steps — confirmed requests now honor header overrides even with existing session cookie. :thumbsup:
Ajay K: Nice. Add a note to rollout playbook about this caveat.
Maria D: Will do. Closing thread.
